name: Selia Bluespirit
original_name: セリア・ブルースピリット
source:
"How naive. You think you are a match for me at that level?"

She has a very serious personality and, although she's not impolite, she doesn't get closer to other than is necessary. She often give a cold, intimidating impression to those around her. However once she has acknowledged someone as a comrade, she will protect them no matter what.
